entities.name: Ermek Köşerbaev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ermek Bedelbaiūly Köşerbaev is a Kazakh politician and diplomat who is serving as Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Kazakhstan since 26 September 2025. Previously, he was Deputy Prime Minister of Kazakhstan from 14 February to 26 September 2025 and akim of the East Kazakhstan Region from 2023 to 2025, and Kazakh ambassador to Russia from 2020 to 2023. He holds the diplomatic rank of Adviser of the First Class.
